create_quantlinear_layer: create a QuantLinear layer with 4-bit symmetric quantization and group size 128
create_quantlinear_gptq_layer: create a QuantLinearGPTQ layer for GPTQ-style 4-bit quantized linear transformation
create_quantlinear_awq_layer: create a QuantLinearAWQ layer for AWQ-style 4-bit quantized linear transformation
unpack_quantized_weights: unpack packed quantized weights and zeros to 8-bit signed tensors using unpack_to_8bit_signed
dequantize_weight: dequantize packed weights back to full precision using dequantize_weight with scales and bits
post_init_model: run ark_post_init on a model to repack all QuantLinear modules for inference
review_quantlinear_post_init: review the QuantLinear post_init method that repacks weights via the ARK kernel
test_quantlinear_forward: test the QuantLinear forward pass with a bfloat16 input tensor on CPU
